definitions.gloss: passenger ship; cruise ship; ocean liner
definitions.explanation: A ship designed primarily for carrying passengers, including ferries and cruise ships.

examples.japanese: {大型|おおがた}{客船|きゃくせん}が{港|みなと}に{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: A large passenger ship entered the harbor.

examples.japanese: {客船|きゃくせん}で{地中海|ちちゅうかい}を{巡|めぐ}るツアーに{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I joined a tour cruising the Mediterranean on a passenger ship.

examples.japanese: この{客船|きゃくせん}には{二千人|にせんにん}の{乗客|じょうきゃく}が{乗|の}れるそうだ。
examples.english: I hear this cruise ship can carry two thousand passengers.

notes:
USAGE:
Distinguished from {貨物船|かもつせん} (cargo ship). {客船|きゃくせん} covers everything from ferries to luxury cruise liners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大型|おおがた}{客船|きゃくせん} (large passenger ship)
- {豪華|ごうか}{客船|きゃくせん} (luxury cruise ship)
- {客船|きゃくせん}ターミナル (passenger ship terminal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フェリー: ferry — a specific type of passenger ship for regular routes
- {貨物船|かもつせん}: cargo ship — a ship primarily for freight
